title: Introduce intake-contract sanitizer and release-hint engine
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a new ingest-time sanitizer for intake manifests and a release-hint engine that auto-suggests changelog fragments for model onboarding. Backwards compatible; opt-in via registry config key 'autohint.enabled'.
description: Motivation: onboarding churn and noisy release notes for small model variants make it hard for release owners to write compact, useful changelogs. This PR implements two cooperating pieces: (1) an intake-contract sanitizer that enforces/normalizes required metadata (licenses, provenance, minimal perf profile) and emits machine-readable correction hints; (2) a release-hint engine that consumes sanitizer output plus sampled telemetry to synthesize short changelog paragraphs and classification hints (bugfix/behavioral-change/perf). Summary of changes: validation rules for intake manifests, deterministic normalizers for alias/variant fields, a sanitizer CLI and webhook, a lightweight release-hint service with scoring heuristics, and a new Linear-linked suggestion endpoint for the web UI. Checklist: [x] contract validator + unit tests [x] sanitizer CLI + Dockerfile [x] webhook integration with intake API [x] release-hint scoring and templates [x] end-to-end integration test harness [x] docstrings and public API docs. Rollout plan: the sanitizer runs in dry-run mode by default and writes suggested corrections to a new 'intake_suggestion' audit table; operators can enable auto-apply per-namespace. The release-hint engine is gated behind 'autohint.enabled' and will surface suggestions in the registry UI and as draft changelog snippets in the onboarding flow. Impact/compatibility: no forced rejection of existing manifests while dry-run is enabled. When auto-apply is turned on, small normalizations (alias trimming, license canonicalization) are idempotent; teams will be notified via the suggestion webhook. Testing notes: added 38 unit tests, simulated 2k synthetic intake manifests in the integration harness to validate failure modes and suggestion quality, and ran the hint generator against a 90-day sample of telemetry to tune scoring thresholds. Related work: follows up on ENG-2142 (onboard contract stability) and complements ENG-2201 (release automation).

human_summary: Adds an intake-time sanitizer that normalizes and suggests fixes for incoming model manifests and a release-hint service that drafts concise changelog snippets using telemetry. Dry-run by default; opt-in auto-apply. Improves onboarding quality and reduces manual work creating release notes.
